identity.fantasy: A mobile C'Thun affliction caster who carpets targets in Darkwither, grows an eye-and-beam network, and turns accumulated Insanity into escalating void pressure.
identity.one_line: Apply and preserve Darkwither, use periodic damage to accelerate Obliteration Beam and Gaze, then choose between controlled 60-Insanity pressure and a Wrath-heavy 100-Insanity state.

mechanics.core_loop: Open with Darkwither, establish Tentacle and C'Thun effects, fire Obliteration Beam and Gaze as the DoTs accelerate them, and use Psychic Suppression or Horrorbolt while refreshing rather than tunneling one target. Sanity Tap converts the resource back into mana when the danger window permits.
mechanics.single_target: The captured PvP sequence is Darkwither, Tentacle, Obliteration Beam, Gaze, then Psychic Suppression; longer PvE fights add refresh discipline and Wrath of the Black Empire decisions.
mechanics.aoe: Spread Darkwither, tab-refresh it, use Eldritch Devastation when enough enemies are grouped, and exploit beam and Gaze cooldowns. Multi-DoT pressure is the point rather than a single instant nuke.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Many core spells can be applied while repositioning, but channels, hard-cast Wrath, and placed tentacles still punish abrupt target changes.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Grasp, fear, Void Shield, Corrupt Mind, Abyssal Ward, and Hallucination give a broad control and survival kit; it is strong only if woven between DoT refreshes.
mechanics.group_utility: Cultist fears, slows, healing denial, and pressure across several targets create disruption even before a kill.

failure_modes.text: Letting Darkwither expire breaks the periodic-damage engine that feeds beam pressure.
Accidentally reaching 100 Insanity can expose the caster before Wrath or defensive tools are ready.
Tunneling one target wastes the spec's ability to spread pressure and shorten cooldowns across a pack.

leveling_10_29.feel: A DoT caster whose rotation becomes more manageable after the earliest levels, but whose full beam and Insanity network is not yet present.
cautions: Mana and Insanity habits are still forming

leveling_30_49.feel: Darkwither spread, Tentacle, Beam, Gaze, and Sanity Tap form a real multi-target pressure loop.

level_50_60.feel: A mature affliction controller balancing DoT coverage, beam cadence, mana conversion, and whether to approach the dangerous Wrath state.

boss.feel: Maintain the full periodic package and convert its ticks into repeated beam and eye payoffs without clipping refreshes.

dungeon_aoe.feel: Tag widely, stabilize Darkwither coverage, then channel or detonate only after the tank has settled the pack.
cautions: Fast packs may die during setup

pvp.feel: A spread-pressure caster that kites with Grasp and fears while cycling Beam, Gaze, and Suppression across vulnerable targets.
cautions: Plate does not remove caster burst vulnerability

enjoy_if.text: You like multi-DoT pressure whose ticks accelerate larger eye and beam effects.
You want a caster with enough fears, slows, shields, and mana tools to make many small decisions.

avoid_if.text: You want immediate burst on every new target.
You dislike tab-target upkeep, channels, or a second resource that can become dangerous.

praise.theme: Players who enjoy Corruption emphasize its strong spread pressure, Cultist utility, and increasingly coherent loop after the earliest levels.

frustrations.theme: Documentation is sparse, and the setup can feel clunky when targets die before Darkwither and beam interactions mature.

contested.theme: PvP praise and the small PvE performance sample answer different questions; the profile does not treat either as a universal verdict.

gaps: No current detailed PvE boss guide.
Exact beam cooldown acceleration and ideal Wrath cadence need live combat verification.
